svg.text: The étale picture: looking through the core
Forget the Frobenius-like part of every theater and what remains can be laid out as spokes around one shared core, the D⊢-prime-strip. The only line of sight from ‡ to † runs down
a spoke, through the core and up another spoke, and what arrives is known only up to three indeterminacies.
hatched in the ring angle of its own universe;
no two bands share a ring structure
a D-Θ±ell NF-Hodge theater: Π_v and labels only
the core does not know which is which
What the observer in ‡ can rebuild of †
in S±_(j+1), up to (j+1)!, and Aut(G_v)
the units O×μ are shared only up to an
correspondence: the region is only contained
in the log-shell, an upper bound
outline only: a type, not a set
Every chip names a data type of the toolkit (species ids of `iut species`, C structs of src/iut.h). All numbers are read from `iut walk`.
